changes: Renamed DirectJmp Kyoti, short for Direct Jump Kyoti, as its author asked (#881), so it stays apart from other direct-jump designs.
No change to how it works.
Fixes a Plays Free MIDI track with trig quantize DIRECT stalling after its first step in PER TRACK scale mode (#881). This is Zac Kyoti's own fix, now built into Direct Jump.
With that fix, Direct Jump places such a MIDI track with its own scale instead of the master's.
Known issue: the MIDI fix has not yet been tried on an MKII; the author tested it on his MKI.
First Modwerk release of Zac Kyoti's Direct Jump: hold [PTN] and press [YES], and a pattern you cue takes over on the next step instead of at the end of the playing one.
The new pattern starts where it would be had it played since PLAY, also with other lengths and per-track scales. Part, START SILENT and trig conditions change as on a stock pattern change.
Off at every power-on; while off, or while the arranger or a chain runs, pattern changes are the stock ones.
For card builds and, for beta testers, over USB.
Known issue: not yet tested on a unit with a jump into another Part, per-track scales, external MIDI gear, the arranger or chains, or on an MKI.
